2º de Bachillerato · Inglés II

Examen de prueba del 2º trimestre

Temas: Reported speech and reporting verbs · Relative clauses and participle clauses · Verb patterns and phrasal verbs · Linking words and connectors.

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________   Nota: ______

  1. «She ___ me she was busy.»

  2. «I'm tired» → She said she ___ tired.

  3. «I've finished» → He said he ___ finished.

  4. «I'll call you» → She said she ___ call me.

  5. «I can drive» → He said he ___ drive.

  6. «I saw it yesterday» → She said she had seen it ___.

  7. Sin backshift (sigue siendo verdad):

  8. «Where do you work?» → He asked me where ___.

  9. «Are you ready?» → She asked ___ I was ready.

  10. «Do you want it or not?» → He asked ___ or not I wanted it.

  11. «Sit down» → She told us ___ down.

  12. «Don't be late» → He told me ___ late.

  13. «Let's go out» → She suggested ___ out.

  14. «You should rest» → The doctor ___ me to rest.

  15. «I won't do it» → He ___ to do it.

  16. «I didn't steal it» → He denied ___ it.

  17. «Sorry I'm late» → She apologised ___ late.

  18. «You lied!» → They accused him ___.

  19. «Well done on your exam!» → He congratulated me ___ the exam.

  20. «This could be true, but we can't prove it» encaja con el verbo…

  21. Rewrite: «I am working on a new project», she said. → She said ___.

  22. Rewrite: «When will the results be published?» I asked. → I asked ___.

  23. Rewrite: «Did you see the match?» he asked me. → He asked me ___.

  24. Rewrite: «Don't forget to lock the door», Mum said to me. → Mum reminded ___.

  25. Rewrite: «Why don't we have a picnic?» said Lucía. → Lucía suggested ___.

  26. Find the mistake: «He apologised to break the window.»

  27. Rewrite: «Yes, I copied in the exam», said Dani. → Dani admitted ___.

  28. Choose the best summary: «Hello! Thank you all for coming. I'm afraid the speaker is ill, so the talk is cancelled.»

  29. «The man ___ car was stolen called the police.»

  30. «My mother, ___ is a nurse, works nights.»

  31. «This is the book ___ I told you about.»

  32. Frase en la que se puede omitir el pronombre:

  33. «The house ___ I was born has been demolished.»

  34. «The person to ___ I spoke was helpful.»

  35. «The hotel ___ we stayed in was cheap.»

  36. «I have ten cousins, most of ___ live in Chile.»

  37. «He sold all his paintings, some of ___ were very valuable.»

  38. «She passed all her exams, ___ made her parents proud.»

  39. «___ he said made me angry.»

  40. «You can come ___ you want.»

  41. «The woman ___ next to me was very nervous.»

  42. «The bridge ___ in 1890 is still in use.»

  43. «He was the youngest player ___ a goal.»

  44. «I need someone to talk ___.»

  45. «___ the exam, we went to celebrate.»

  46. «___ what to do, she called her mother.»

  47. «The fire spread quickly, ___ several buildings.»

  48. Frase correcta (sin sujeto colgante):

  49. Join: «I visited a museum. It has a famous collection of Goya paintings.»

  50. Join: «That's the actress. Her latest film won an Oscar.»

  51. Join: «He has written five books. All of them are bestsellers.»

  52. Rewrite: «The people who live next door are very noisy.»

  53. Rewrite: «As soon as she had read the letter, she burst into tears.»

  54. Find the mistake: «The team won the cup, what was a great surprise.»

  55. Rewrite: «Neil Armstrong was the first man who walked on the Moon.»

  56. Choose the most formal option for an essay.

  57. «I avoid ___ sugar.»

  58. «She refused ___ the contract.»

  59. «They made us ___ for an hour.»

  60. «I'd like you ___ me.»

  61. «I can't help ___ when I see that video.»

  62. «The museum is worth ___.»

  63. «Don't forget ___ the lights off.»

  64. «I'll never forget ___ the Pyramids.»

  65. «She stopped ___ a coffee on the way.»

  66. «If the soup is bland, try ___ some pepper.»

  67. «I look forward to ___ from you.»

  68. «She's used to ___ alone.»

  69. «He denied ___ the money.»

  70. «I hate ___ lied to.»

  71. «I saw him ___ the street.» (de principio a fin)

  72. «We've run ___ of milk.»

  73. «Can you pick ___ at the station?»

  74. «The match was called ___ because of the rain.»

  75. «It took her weeks to get ___ the flu.»

  76. Equivalente formal de «put off»:

  77. Complete: «Students are not allowed ___ their phones in class.»

  78. Rewrite: «I'm sorry I shouted at you.» → «I regret ___.»

  79. Rewrite: «Don't hesitate to call me.» → «I look forward ___.»

  80. Choose the correct option: «My grandmother taught me ___.»

  81. Find the mistake: «Her parents don't let her to go out on weekdays.»

  82. Complete: «Many young people find it hard to keep up ___ the cost of living.»

  83. Replace the phrasal verb with a formal verb: «The police are looking into the case.»

  84. Choose the best sentence for an essay.

  85. «___ it was late, we kept talking.»

  86. «___ the rain, we went out.»

  87. «In spite of ___ tired, she finished.»

  88. Puntuación correcta:

  89. «I love jazz, ___ my parents hate it.»

  90. «The flight was delayed ___ fog.»

  91. «___ it was a holiday, the shops were closed.»

  92. «It was ___ a good book that I read it twice.»

  93. «The book was ___ good that I read it twice.»

  94. «Prices rose. ___, demand fell.»

  95. «I left early ___ miss the bus.»

  96. «Speak louder ___ everyone can hear you.»

  97. «___, I'd like to thank my family.» (primero)

  98. «We waited for hours. ___, the bus arrived!»

  99. «Some animals, ___ dolphins, are very intelligent.»

  100. «Actually» significa…

  101. «The film wasn't sad. ___, it was hilarious.»

  102. «She is ___ intelligent but also very kind.»

  103. «___, the report says unemployment will rise.»

  104. Conector ideal para concluir un for and against essay:

  105. Rewrite: «Although she was nervous, she gave a great speech.» → «Despite ___.»

  106. Rewrite: «We cancelled the trip because the weather was bad.» → «We cancelled the trip because ___.»

  107. Rewrite: «The exam was so difficult that many students failed.» → «It was ___.»

  108. Rewrite: «I wrote it down. I didn't want to forget it.» → «I wrote it down so ___.»

  109. Find the mistake: «Although the hotel was expensive, but the rooms were small.»

  110. Complete: «___ the fact that he had little experience, he got the job.»

  111. Choose the correct punctuation.

  112. Choose the best opening for a paragraph against an idea.
